text: Charles H. Spurgeon’s Timeless Daily Devotional — Renewed for Modern Readers

For more than 150 years, Charles Haddon Spurgeon’s Morning and Evening has been one of the most cherished daily devotionals in the Christian world. Across 732 meditations—one for every morning and every evening of the year, including Leap Day—Spurgeon unfolds the riches of Scripture with unmatched pastoral warmth, theological depth, and Christ-centered clarity.

Spurgeon wrote in the rich Victorian English of the 1860s, steeped in the Elizabethan vocabulary of the 1611 King James Bible. While deeply poetic, archaic words, obsolete idioms, and marathon 300-word Victorian paragraphs can sometimes obscure his message for modern readers.

Updated Morning and Evening bridges that gap. The Modern Edition carefully updates archaic vocabulary and grammar into clear, natural contemporary English while faithfully preserving 100% of Spurgeon’s theology, conviction, imagery, and pastoral heart—never watered down, abridged, or paraphrased into clichés.

Whether you love the clarity of the Modern Edition (paired with the Berean Standard Bible) or the cadence of Spurgeon’s Classic Edition (paired with the King James Version), you can switch between them at any moment with a single tap—and even export either complete edition as an EPUB book.

Every detail of this app was crafted to remove distractions and help you linger over Scripture: six custom page layouts (from fine-press book typography to clause-stepped sentence cadence and reflection cards), adaptive day and night themes, personal reflection notes, flexible reading schedules, a Home screen verse widget, and gentle local reminders.

This app does not even request Internet permission. There are no accounts, no ads, no analytics, and no tracking of any kind. Your saved readings, progress, and personal notes stay strictly on your device.

Scripture quotations in the Modern Edition are taken from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB), which has been dedicated to the public domain. We gratefully acknowledge the Berean Bible Translation Committee and Bible Hub for making this faithful, accurate, and readable translation freely available. Scripture quotations in the Classic Edition are from the King James Version (KJV).
